publication_summary: Two very uncertain parent hypotheses join one existing seven-profile family to the working tree. They are one shared family reconstruction, not two independent proofs. No new person, merge, original manuscript inspection, live WikiTree save or certainty upgrade is claimed. The confidently marked measurements remain unchanged, and working connectivity does not validate the inherited Scottish–Maryland identity. Ann’s unsupported local birth estimate is corrected to unknown; the captured WikiTree fields remain unchanged. Selected James Glasgow-2868 and Ann Hartshorne-320 as very uncertain parents of Robert Glasgow-395, through possible identity with the 1786 Cecil Robert/Joshua Hartshorn co-party. James’s Scottish–Maryland identity and Ann’s surname remain unproved; the family summary omits Robert, and a collateral or business route remains possible. Largest working family through 1850 grows from 1,028 to 1,035 retained profiles; separate components 425 to 424, multi-child roots 47 to 46. Four complete proposals retain all prior citations and family information.
